snippet.title: SONAR - Official Announcement Trailer | Sci-Fi Survival Horror
snippet.description:
Wishlist SONAR on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836790/SONAR/&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=announcement_2026_08_18&utm_content=youtube

Sounds help you see in the dark, but they may also attract other unwanted things...

SONAR is a sci-fi survival horror game where sound is your best chance at seeing the caves of an alien planet.

Fire visible SONAR pulses, explore procedurally-authored generated caves, research unknown creatures, and survive in the dark.

#sonar #indiehorror #survivalhorror #indiegame
